The main agent restored the cart-discount UI (request btn, pending/approved badges, modal, per-item note, checkout-cart-wide-discount-line) inside /app/frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.js, but that file is DEAD CODE — it is not imported/rendered anywhere. rca of the issue: Root cause: React Router config in /app/frontend/src/App.js line 143 declares <Route path="/checkout" element={<Navigate to="/cart" replace />}/> — a hard redirect. CheckoutPage.js is not imported anywhere and never mounts. The recently 'restored' computation block plus request/approve UI inside CheckoutPage.js therefore never renders. CartPage.js (the actual rendered component at /cart AND at /checkout after redirect) never implemented any cart-wide-discount client UI. Reproduction: 1) login user@demo.com/demo123; 2) navigate to /checkout; 3) observe URL becomes /cart; 4) inspect for [data-testid=request-cart-discount-btn] — absent; 5) inspect for [data-testid=cart-discount-approved-badge] and [data-testid=checkout-cart-wide-discount-line] — both absent. Mitigation: either replace the Navigate with CheckoutPage as element (+ import), or port the ~120 lines of cart-discount UI from CheckoutPage.js (block around lines 77, 118-121, 142-166, 800-956) into CartPage.js.
